name: Porthos
source: Porthos is a navigator stationed aboard the Sleipnir and close friend of [url=/c33425]Phobos[/url]. He seems to share Phobos' dislike of their fellow navigator, [url=/c33376]Abel[/url]. He pilots the Pharaon, and is partnered with his fighter, Athos.
